card.name: Scattered mix, tri- in dictionary origins
card.fires_on: The strongest hits are the prefix tri in tricuspid etymology entries. Other hits are scattered: 'may increase' in interaction text, 'is' in trial purpose text, and name endings.

modes.label: Drug interaction wording
modes.description: The word increase after 'may' in drug interaction statements, or the end of a drug name.
modes.example: Coadministration with VOSEVI may<< increase>> the concentrations of atorvastatin
